findings.title: Insufficient Bank Statement Period

source.text: Bank statements cover September 2024 to October 2024 only - a total of 2 months coverage for an £875,000 transaction by an overseas client.

reference.text: For high-value transactions exceeding £500,000 or overseas clients, a minimum of 6 months bank statements must be obtained to evidence legitimate accumulation of funds.

findings.deviation: Only 2 months of bank statements obtained. Transaction value is £875,000 and client is overseas resident - policy requires minimum 6 months coverage.
